meta.title: OfficeSDK · Default style skills
meta.description: Start Word documents and PowerPoint presentations with built-in styles. In Word, draft meeting minutes, weekly reports, product requirements, project plans, proposals, and formal letters. In PowerPoint, create team updates, training decks, and knowledge-sharing presentations. Both can start from a blank page or slide. The styles ship with the plugin, and your own skills of the same name take precedence.
